title: TRUMPF
summary: German laser and machine-tool group supplying EUV drive lasers and industrial photonics.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

TRUMPF builds industrial lasers, machine tools and photonics systems, and supplies the drive laser used in ASML's EUV lithography tools through a long-standing partnership. Its laser expertise also serves battery welding, additive manufacturing and quantum applications. The company is family-owned and one of Europe's largest machine-tool makers.

Technology Exposure

  • EUV drive lasers
  • Industrial lasers and machine tools
  • Laser welding and additive systems

What To Watch

  • EUV lithography demand
  • Battery and automotive capex
  • Industrial machinery cycle

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
